notes.title: Jelly Block 1.1 released
notes.content:
New features:
[list]
[*] Added control summary to gameplay screen for controller and gamepad
[*] Added credits screen
[/list]

Bugs fixed:
[list]
[*] Location of the timeout counter in challenge mode fixed
[*] Improved the floaty-ness of the jelly block watermarks, they no longer render a frame behind the physics engine
[/list]

notes.title: Post Release Plans
notes.content:
Jelly Blocks 1.0 goes live tomorrow (April 11th), but work on it continues.

In the next couple of weeks updates will include:
[list]
[*] Adding a controls summary to the game UI. Jelly Blocks is supposed to be a super simple to play game and some people find the two stick controls counter intuitive.
[*] Graphics that visually indicate the blocks freeze mechanic
[*] A fix for the annoying blocks overlays are slightly off center bug
[*] Fixes for user reported bug
[*] Internal updates to support new game modes
[/list]

In the next couple of months, planned updates are:
[list]
[*] Steam achievements
[*] Steam cloud saves
[*] New game modes
[/list]

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Jelly Blocks coming to Steam April 11th
notes.content:
Hello world. After far too long in development I'm releasing my squish blocks game on Steam on April 11th. Along with like 157 other random little indies games on the same day Im sure :)

The release date looks incorrect on the store page and there are some formatting errors; those will be fixed shortly.
